spans.text: GENPACT INDIA PVT.LTD / 09/2021 - 08/2024
Developed interactive dashboards using Advanced Excel, Power BI, and
Oracle, providing end-to-end visibility of supply chain processes.
Built relationships between multiple data tables, defined calculated
columns, measures, and hierarchies to structure and organize data in
Power BI and Excel.
Designed visually appealing dashboards with tables, charts, and maps
to present actionable insights.
Created custom calculations and measures using DAX formulas to
perform advanced analytics in Power BI.
Transformed and cleaned data using Power Query Editor, including
merging, splitting, and unpivoting data.
Published reports to Power BI Service, managing permissions, data
refresh schedules, and collaboration with stakeholders.
Implemented role-based security in Power BI to restrict access and
ensure data confidentiality.
Wrote advanced SQL queries to retrieve, filter, and analyze data from
multiple sources.
Performed JOIN operations to integrate data from multiple tables for
comprehensive analysis.
Applied aggregate functions (SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN) to
calculate metrics like total sales, average order value, and inventory
levels.
Executed INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE statements for database
management and maintained data integrity.
Utilized WHERE clauses and ORDER BY to filter and organize query
results for reporting purposes.
Integrated data from ERP systems, databases, APIs, and external files
using Python.
Automated ETL processes, data cleaning, transformation, and report
generation using Python scripts.
Applied Python for data security, encryption, authentication, and
compliance with GDPR/HIPAA standards.
Processed large volumes of supply chain data using Python libraries for
filtering, aggregation, normalization, and sorting.
Forecasted demand, managed inventory, and planned replenishment
cycles to prevent stockouts or overstock situations.
Served as a liaison between Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, Finance,
and IT, providing analytical insights to stakeholders.
Reported KPIs to account managers, directors, and senior management
on a weekly and monthly basis.
Conducted quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify trends and
operational inefficiencies.
Managed vendor and customer relationships to ensure smooth supply
chain operations.
Hands-on experience in Purchase Order creation, release, scheduling
agreements, goods issue, and goods receipt.
Participated in weekly client calls to discuss forecasting, inventory
issues, and process improvement initiatives.
Assisted in developing, writing, and approving SOPs to enhance
business processes.
Built and maintained effective relationships with key stakeholders and
team members.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal and communication skills-
, supporting cross-functional collaboration.
Developed acumen in defining KPIs and identifying operational trends
to improve supply chain efficiency.
SENIOR ANALYST
ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT.LTD / 08/2024 - PRESENT
Designed and delivered People analytics and business intelligence
solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and Advanced Excel to support
workforce and organizational decision-making.
Built and maintained interactive Power BI dashboards to analyze
employee compensation, equity, and workforce metrics across multiple
geographies including US, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
Using Power Query Editor to transform and clean data before loading
it into Power BI. This includes tasks such as data cleansing, merging,
splitting, and unpivoting.
Published and shared reports and dashboards to the Power BI
Service, setting up data refresh schedules, managing permissions, and
collaborating with team members.
Developed and optimized complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs,
aggregations) to extract, transform, and validate large-scale HR
datasets from multiple source systems.
Created efficient Power BI data models and implemented DAX
calculations to enable trend analysis, regional comparisons, and
leadership reporting.
Automated end-to-end data extraction and reporting workflows using
Python, improving data refresh reliability and reducing manual effort.
Implemented Python scripts to fetch source data from source systems
and load it into downstream reporting and promotion tools.
Performed data quality checks, reconciliation, and validation using SQL
and Excel to ensure accuracy of sensitive compensation and equity
data.
Utilized Advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables, lookup functions,
macros) for ad-hoc analysis, data cleansing, and stakeholder reporting.
Collaborated with HR, Compensation, and Business stakeholders
to gather requirements and translate them into scalable analytical
solutions.
Ensured adherence to data governance, compliance, and security
standards while handling confidential employee information.
Improved dashboard performance and data refresh times through SQL
optimization and efficient BI design.
Used Python Pandas and NumPy to clean and preprocess raw data
obtained from various sources such as databases, CSV files, or APIs
and this involves tasks such as handling missing values, removing
duplicates, and converting data types.
Leveraged Excel to validate data, perform reconciliations, and generate
summary reports for management and cross-functional teams.

Management.

the current organization.
